preconditions.description: The capability boundary is understood: one plugin-api stage (Detector -> Policy -> Transformer -> Vault) or one protocol surface changes, and the privacy invariants it must preserve (redaction, scope isolation, fail-closed) are written down.
A third-party API, model artifact, coding-client integration, or wire protocol is uncertain; the unknown must be resolved by a throwaway prototype before a slice is committed.

A design or dependency verdict (adopt, hold, reject) is being recorded in plans/invariants.json with its invariant/rationale/sensor/category header. Feature-gated surfaces (for example --features gliner2) are verified with an explicit feature build, not the default suite.
